issues.description: Farm's animal collection type contradicts the specification: the problem statement/UML requires `animals: List<Animal>` implemented as an `ArrayList` (preserving insertion order and allowing duplicates), but the solution declares `private Set<Animal> animals` and initializes it with `new HashSet<>()`, changing both type and iteration order (affecting verse order in `singFarmSong()`) and duplicate handling.
issues.suggestedFix: Align Farm with the spec by changing `animals` to `private List<Animal> animals;` and initializing it in the no-arg constructor with `new ArrayList<>()`; update getter/setter signatures and usages (`addAnimal`, loops in `feedAllAnimals`/`singFarmSong`) accordingly. Alternatively, if a Set is intended, update the UML and written instructions to specify `Set<Animal>`/`HashSet` and clarify ordering implications.
